   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      10 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 07.07.2026 - 13.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _deederola_, 13.09.2026, 1/5: "Please give us the option to revert. It’s annoying to have to click through so much, the new UI is ugly and counterintuitive. It makes the app unusable."
            2. _The Winter Empress_, 12.09.2026, 1/5: "Been using this since college days (2019) and despite the bugs over the years, I never stopped using it. Now I’m uninstalling it. Not sure if the developers know how useful the completion sound was, but removing that was the deal breaker. Before, when background sound was on, I’d know my session was done just by it turning off. Now since the update, I’ve been wasting time and my productivity’s messed up. Maybe some updates later this would be fixed but until then I won’t be using this again and I won’t recommend it to anyone either"
            3. _Keith Gold_, 08.09.2026, 1/5: "They recently updated the UI, this is how I know they do not use the app themselves, if it’s not broken why change it, please change the app to how it was before this terrible upgrade"
